text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-development thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"clear stance","description":"The essay states its position up front and consistently argues for continuing driverless-car development."},{"evidence":"three separate benefit paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is structured into distinct sections that each develop one main reason, making the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"explains fuel, flexibility, and safety claims","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands its points with multiple supporting ideas rather than stopping at a single quotation or claim."},{"evidence":"“Some people may say...” paragraph","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges an opposing concern and answers it, which strengthens the persuasiveness of the argument."},{"evidence":"uses phrases like “However” and “Another way”","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses transitions to connect ideas and guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement with future recommendation","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending summarizes the case and closes with a forward-looking recommendation rather than just repeating the topic."}]}
